name: Vol'jin
guide_text: With [[Flaming Enforcer||126924]] or [[Unbound Tempest||132983]], you can exponentially scale attack by swapping largest attack with unit in the shop. In the end, make a large cleave ([[Blade Collector||99035]])
buddy_guide_text: You must use this buddy with [[Tarecgosa||72062]] or [[Persistent Poet||108463]] which will add a ton of permanent HP. Even better if you hit [[Wrathscale Rogue]] to convert that HP to permanent attack, which means exponential scaling.
